item.title: "Creeped out by her face": Erika Kirk’s eerie reaction on podcast triggers internet frenzy over Candace Owens remark
item.description: Erika Kirk is facing online backlash after a viral clip from The Charlie Kirk Show showed her making remarks about Candace Owens. Viewers focused on her facial expressions, calling them “unsettling,” while others criticized her statement about dehumanization. Social media reactions have been mixed, with some questioning her demeanor and others defending her amid ongoing scrutiny and intense online debate.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: IShowSpeed seen struggling before collapsing live in St Maarten as viral clip sparks health fears
item.description: IShowSpeed collapsed during a livestream in St Maarten, leaving fans worried after a viral clip showed him unresponsive. Many believe exhaustion or heat may have played a role. He later returned online, easing concerns. The streamer is currently on a Caribbean travel tour with Expedia, and fans are now hoping he takes better care moving forward.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: UK: ‘Islamic sect’ members arrested following allegations of sexual abuse and slavery
item.description: Over 500 officers stormed an "Islamic sect" in Crewe, arresting 10 members, including their spiritual leader, for serious crimes like rape, sexual assault, and human trafficking. The raid targeted the Ahmadi Religion of Peace and Light headquarters. Police are investigating allegations of forced marriage and slavery reported by a former member.
item.dc:creator: Naomi Canton

item.title: Candace Owens raises doubts over Erika Kirk TPUSA tour future after WHCD shooting and low turnout
item.description: Candace Owens claims Erika Kirk may cancel her TPUSA tour after the WHCD shooting, but there is no official confirmation yet. Erika appeared emotional after the incident and said she is spending time with family. Meanwhile, reports of low turnout at JD Vance’s event and student protests have added more questions around the future of the tour.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: 'Don't want to look 20 pounds heavier': Trump jabs reports of wearing bulletproof vest during White House dinner attack
item.description: President Trump dismissed reports of wearing a bulletproof vest, joking about the added weight. He acknowledged security considerations but expressed reluctance to appear overly protected. Trump stated he avoids dwelling on personal security threats to remain effective in his duties, following an attempted assassination at a White House event.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘I have five’: Ronaldo shuts down disrespect after problematic post-match drama in Al Nassr vs Al Ahli
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo led Al Nassr to a crucial 2–0 win over Al Ahli, scoring the opener before tensions took over the match. Confrontations involving Merih Demiral, post-match accusations, and Ronaldo’s pointed response to fans shifted focus beyond the result, highlighting both a fierce rivalry and wider issues around refereeing and the league’s image.
item.dc:creator: TOI Sports Desk

item.title: Erika Kirk faces fresh backlash as Ashley St Clair questions Druski skit reaction after Charlie Kirk show clip
item.description: Ashley St. Clair reacted to Erika Kirk’s comments about Druski’s skit, questioning her response and advising her to step back from public pressure. The discussion began after Erika spoke on The Charlie Kirk Show and explained her frustration with media coverage and her appearance at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner, which added more attention to the ongoing debate.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Millions of graphene toothbrushes sold worldwide: Scientists reveal why people are buying them
item.description: New research from KAIST has clarified how graphene oxide's antibacterial properties work, revealing it selectively attacks harmful bacteria by targeting a specific lipid found in their membranes. This mechanism explains the success of graphene-based hygiene products and offers a novel approach to combating antibiotic resistance by physically disrupting bacterial structures.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: D4vd case update: Celeste Rivas death certificate sparks questions as pregnancy status listed unknown
item.description: Celeste Rivas Hernandez's death certificate has been updated, now stating her pregnancy status in the year prior to her death is unknown, a change from previous reports. The document also confirms her cause of death as "multiple penetrating injuries" and manner as "homicide," with other details like the exact injury circumstances now listed as unknown.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: IShowSpeed plans space livestream after completing world tour goal
item.description: Popular streamer IShowSpeed revealed his ambitious plan to stream live from space after completing his goal of visiting all the world's countries. Having already traveled to 96 nations, he aims to finish his global tour in the next two to three years. Following this, he intends to embark on an unprecedented journey to space, potentially seeking assistance from Elon Musk.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: 'Time to say goodbye' :Jeffrey Epstein's suicide note revealed via former cellmate account, remains sealed by court
item.description: A recently surfaced report reveals Jeffrey Epstein penned a note before his 2019 death in a New York federal jail. Discovered by his cellmate, Nicholas Tartaglione, the handwritten message, now sealed by a judge, reportedly asserted Epstein's innocence and included the poignant phrase, "Time to say goodbye.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Trump aide Josh Gruenbaum dropped from Ukraine, Iran roles: Here's why he was sidelined
item.description: Josh Gruenbaum, formerly an adviser to Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff on Russia-Ukraine and Iran policy, will now exclusively focus on Gaza Strip issues through the independent Board of Peace. This shift follows internal concerns about his working style, reducing his responsibilities from key foreign policy matters.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Make Pluto a planet again': Nasa Administrator Jared Isaacman calls for status restoration at US Senate hearing
item.description: Nasa Administrator Jared Isaacman wants Pluto to be a planet again. He voiced this support in a Senate hearing. Nasa researchers are studying Pluto's status. Pluto was a planet until 2006. The International Astronomical Union reclassified it as a dwarf planet. This decision is still debated by scientists and the public. Isaacman believes Pluto should be a planet.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Mother convicted of baby’s murder after blaming another child
item.description: A Glasgow judge found Nicole Blain guilty of killing her infant daughter, Thea June Wilson, in Greenock. Evidence presented at trial showed the child suffered severe head injuries, including three skull fractures, consistent with forceful shaking and collision. Blain attempted to blame another child but her defense was contradicted by medical records and witness testimony.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Britain extracted 25 million years of life and labour through slavery in Barbados: Report
item.description: British colonial practices in Barbados resulted in the loss of nearly 25 million years of life and forced labor from enslaved Africans, with estimated economic losses reaching £1.6 trillion. Researchers used economic modeling and historical data to quantify this exploitation, aiming to foster understanding and reconciliation rather than demanding payment.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Move over TACO, NACHO takes over: Trump earns new nickname amid oil disruption from Strait of Hormuz blockade
item.description: Market analysts have shifted from the 'TACO' nickname for President Trump to 'NACHO' amid escalating tensions over the Strait of Hormuz. This new label reflects growing skepticism that the crucial global energy route will reopen soon, despite ongoing diplomatic efforts and trade disputes.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: F1 to return in 2027 to country absent from calendar since 2021 under new multi-year agreement
item.description: The Turkish Grand Prix will return to the Formula 1 calendar in 2027 under a multi-year agreement confirmed on April 24, keeping Istanbul Park on the schedule through 2031. The move restores a circuit last used in 2021, known for its demanding layout and iconic Turn 8, as F1 continues reshaping its calendar with global expansion and venue changes.
item.dc:creator: TOI Sports Desk

item.title: Forget Ronaldo: João Cancelo set for historic record no player has ever achieved if Barca win La Liga
item.description: João Cancelo is on the brink of a unique European football milestone, with a potential La Liga title at Barcelona set to make him the first player to win four of Europe’s “Big Five” leagues. Having already lifted trophies in Italy, England and Germany, the achievement would surpass Cristiano Ronaldo’s cross-league record and underline Cancelo’s unusual, globe-spanning career path.
item.dc:creator: TOI Sports Desk
